purpose: Teach: 船橋/府中/松村/岡部/江田/栗原/角田/板橋

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、船橋に支店を開設された
lines.en: When you were young, you opened a branch in Funabashi.
lines.style: Quiet, measured recall. Gentle curiosity about the memory. Unhurried pace, like turning the pages of a photo album. Warm respect in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは府中の研究所を建てられた
lines.en: Yes. And your father built that research center in Fuchu.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate acknowledgment. A quiet nod in the voice. Each name and achievement given equal weight, honoring the lineage. Calm, grounded tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、松村氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were young, you launched a joint venture with Matsumura.
lines.style: Same gentle recall as before. A slight softening on the name—affection for the partnership. Unhurried, inviting him to remember alongside you.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは岡部先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. And your father received guidance from Okabe-senpai.
lines.style: Reflective, steady. A pause of respect before the mentor's name. Connecting the thread between generations without commentary. Measured, reverent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、江田氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: When you were young, you planned that overseas expansion with Eda.
lines.style: Same wistful tone as the earlier turns. A hint of the ambition in that era. Gentle, not wistful for the loss—wistful for the moment itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは栗原氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. And your father made Kurihara the cornerstone of our communications.
lines.style: Continuing the steady rhythm. Building the portrait of a generation's choices. Calm, precise in naming roles and responsibilities. Honoring without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、角田氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were young, you established the overseas subsidiary with Tsunoda.
lines.style: The same gentle reminiscence, now at the closing note. A softness that marks the completeness of an era. Unhurried, allowing the weight of these accomplishments to settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは板橋氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. And your father entrusted all legal matters to Itabashi.
lines.style: Quiet closure. A final knot tied carefully. The voice carries respect and the understanding that these were the people, the choices, the foundations. Dignified, grounded—not grandiose.
